NONE: › a device used to control and change the flow of electric current through a machine such as an electric light
變阻器
› a substance in the red blood cells of most people that causes the production of antibodies in the blood
獼因數；Rh（血型）因數
› a monkey from northern India
（産於印度北部的）恆河猴
› speech or writing intended to be effective and influence people
雄辯言辭；煽動性語言
› specialized language the study of the ways of using language effectively
修辭（學）；雄辯（術）
› disapproving clever language that sounds good but is not sincere or has no real meaning
浮誇之詞

example: How far the president will be able to translate his campaign rhetoric into action remains to be seen.
總統在大選中作出的冠冕堂皇的承諾能夠兌現多少尚待觀察。
I was swayed by her rhetoric into donating all my savings to the charity.
她巧言善辯，說得我服服帖帖，把全部儲蓄都捐給了慈善機構。
In reply to the question, he just produced a lot of empty (= meaningless) rhetoric.
他對這個問題的回答只是一大堆空洞的浮誇之詞。

NONE: › Rhetorical speech or writing is intended to seem important or influence people.
詞藻華麗的；浮誇的；修辭的

example: repetition, that tedious rhetorical device
重覆，一種枯燥乏味的修辭伎倆

NONE: › a question, asked in order to make a statement, that does not expect an answer
修辭性疑問（句）；反問句

example: "Why do these things always happen to me?" is a rhetorical question.
「這種事情為甚麽老發生在我身上？」是個修辭性疑問句。

NONE: › one of four forms of writing and speech: description, exposition, narration, and persuasion
修辭策略（寫作或演講的四種格式，即描述、闡述、敘述、說服）
› formal a person who is good at speaking in public, especially someone who is able to influence people
演說家
› specialized language a person who teaches the skill of speaking and writing in an effective way that influences people
修辭學家；修辭學教師

example: Lucian was a famous Greek rhetorician.
盧西恩是有名的古希臘修辭學大師。

NONE: › relating to inflammation of muscles, joints, heart valves, or other parts of the body
風濕性的

example: She has a rheumatic hip.
她的髖關節患了風濕病。

NONE: › a serious disease that causes fever, swelling of the joints (= places where two bones are connected), and possible heart damage
風濕熱
› a medical condition that causes stiffness and pain in the joints (= places where two bones are connected) or muscles of the body
風濕病

example: She suffers from rheumatism.
她患有風濕病。
I can't play the piano any more because I have rheumatism in my fingers.
我不能再彈鋼琴了，因為手指患了風濕病。

NONE: › a disease that causes stiffness, swelling, and pain in the joints (= places where two bones are connected) of the body
類風濕性關節炎
› the study of conditions that make the joints swell
風濕病學
› rheumy eyes have a lot of water in them and are not clear
（眼睛）充滿粘液而渾濁的

example: The old man peered at him with rheumy eyes.
老人睜著一雙充滿粘液而渾濁的眼睛費力地看著他。
